QF.id: VII Other Services Provided by Brokers_24

question.text: The net worth requirement for a portfolio manager is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series VII workbook (page 254), a portfolio manager's net worth must not be less than Rs 5 crores. Portfolio managers registered before this requirement were given 36 months from January 16, 2020 to comply. The Trap: The other amounts (Rs 2 crores, Rs 1 crore, Rs 10 crores) are distractors. The current requirement is Rs 5 crores. Note: Source: NISM Series VII workbook, page 254.
